subject: Benjamin Netanyahu
summary: Attorney General told the High Court Netanyahu had violated the binding conflict-of-interest arrangement but said contempt sanctions were not warranted.
discovery_sources: Attorney General filing via Times of Israel; High Court follow-up
resolution_notes: Limiting legal follow-up already preserved in LEAD-2023-0004. Do not create a duplicate event; preserve that violation and contempt are different legal questions and contempt was not found.
media_status: Existing canonical event media remains complete.

subject: Itamar Ben-Gvir
summary: Cabinet advanced a national-guard proposal sought by Ben-Gvir despite police-chief warnings of operational harm and the attorney general identifying legal obstacles to the draft.
discovery_sources: Times of Israel; police chief letter; attorney-general position
resolution_notes: High-salience governance-risk lead, but the proposal and contemporaneous warnings alone do not establish a concrete management failure, final legal violation or other canonical accountability finding. Ben-Gvir's defense that police bureaucracy had stalled the existing guard is preserved. Do not infer motive.
media_status: No accepted event; no publication media required.

subject: Itamar Ben-Gvir
summary: Ben-Gvir advocated administrative detention/orders against major organized-crime suspects after signing a March letter criticizing administrative detention of four Jewish suspects.
discovery_sources: Times of Israel 2023-04-27; March 14 coalition letter reporting
resolution_notes: Do not force a contradiction. The March letter did not categorically reject administrative detention; it said the tool should be reserved for particularly extreme cases. On April 27 Ben-Gvir explicitly described the homicide wave as an extreme situation and acknowledged the measure was extreme. The selective application issue is politically salient but this record alone does not establish a broken commitment or misconduct finding.
media_status: No accepted event; no publication media required.
